The '''Key To The Town''' is used to enter all buildings in [[Stardew Valley]], regardless of the time. It can be purchased for {{Price|20|gem}} [[Qi Gem]]s from [[Qi's Walnut Room]].

Once obtained, it can be found in the [[Special Items & Powers]] tab in [[the Player]]'s Menu.

Despite its description, it has some restrictions, outlined in the "Notes" section listed below.

==Notes==
* The key functions for homes and most shops in [[Pelican Town]], and at the [[Adventurer's Guild]], [[Carpenter's Shop]], [[Marnie's Ranch]], and the [[Wizard's Tower]].
* The key does not function at homes outside of [[Pelican Town|Town]] (''i.e.,'' [[Leah's Cottage]] and [[Elliott's Cabin]]).
* The key does not function at the [[Movie Theater]] or the [[Oasis]].
* The key does not function during [[Festivals|festival days]].
* For a complete list of shop schedules (with and without the Key To The Town), see [[Shop Schedules]].

==History==
{{History|1.5|Introduced.}}
{{History|1.5.2|Fixed bug preventing the key from working at [[Pierre's General Store]] on [[Days of the Week#Wednesday|Wednesdays]] if the player went the Joja route.}}
{{History|1.6|Now located in the new Special Items & Powers tab instead of the player's wallet.}}
